dialogues.jp: 「ことり」
dialogues.en: "Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Kotori."

dialogues.jp: 返事がない。
dialogues.en: No response.
dialogues.text: No response.

dialogues.jp: 「ことり」
dialogues.en: "Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Kotori."

dialogues.jp: もう一度繰り返すと──。
dialogues.en: I repeated myself again--
dialogues.text: I repeated myself again--

dialogues.jp: ことりが必要以上に｛おび／怯｝えた表情で俺を見た。
dialogues.en: Kotori looked at me, slightly frightened.
dialogues.text: Kotori looked at me, slightly frightened.

dialogues.jp:
「あっ……ゴメン。その、驚かせるつもりはな
　かったんだけど……」
dialogues.en: "Ah... sorry... I didn't mean to scare you..."
dialogues.text: "Ah... sorry... I didn't mean to scare you..."

dialogues.jp: 普通に声をかけたつもりだったのだけど。
dialogues.en: I thought I was talking in a normal voice.
dialogues.text: I thought I was talking in a normal voice.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「き、気にしないでください」
dialogues.en: "D, Don't worry about it..."
dialogues.text: "D, Don't worry about it..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なら良いんだけど……」
dialogues.en: "That's good..."
dialogues.text: "That's good..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「えっと……それで？」
dialogues.en: "Uhm... what did you want?"
dialogues.text: "Uhm... what did you want?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。もう放課後だし。ぼんやりしてないで、
　帰ろうぜ」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, classes are over. If you don't have anything to do,
let's go home."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, classes are over. If you don't have anything to do,
let's go home."

dialogues.jp:
ことりは力無くうなずくと、鞄を手に、席を立っ
た。既に教室からは人が消えていた。
dialogues.en:
The classroom was already empty of people. Kotori feebly
nodded, and I placed my bag on my desk.
dialogues.text:
The classroom was already empty of people. Kotori feebly
nodded, and I placed my bag on my desk.

dialogues.jp: かつかつと、人通りの少ない廊下を歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
The only sounds were that of the other students walking down
the corridor.
dialogues.text:
The only sounds were that of the other students walking down
the corridor.

dialogues.jp:
静かだった。会話が続かない。そもそもことり
は俺の横には並んでいなかった。
dialogues.en:
Everything else was silent. The conversation had stopped.
She just walked silently behind me.
dialogues.text:
Everything else was silent. The conversation had stopped.
She just walked silently behind me.

dialogues.jp:
後頭部に口があるわけでないのに……どうして、
ことりは背中にくっつくようにするんだろう？
dialogues.en:
I didn't have a mouth on the back of my head... why was she
walking so lifelessly behind me?
dialogues.text:
I didn't have a mouth on the back of my head... why was she
walking so lifelessly behind me?

dialogues.jp:
……何だかことりと俺との間に、空気で出来た
壁があるみたいな感じがした。
dialogues.en:
...But I felt like asking her anything now would be like
talking to a wall.
dialogues.text:
...But I felt like asking her anything now would be like
talking to a wall.

dialogues.jp:
見覚えのある女子学生が、廊下を向こうからやっ
て来る。
dialogues.en: We passed by a girl whose face I had in my memory.
dialogues.text: We passed by a girl whose face I had in my memory.

dialogues.jp:
誰だったっけ──すれ違ったところで、顔と名
前が一致した。
dialogues.en:
I don't remember who exactly-- I still hadn't gotten far
enough to match names to faces.
dialogues.text:
I don't remember who exactly-- I still hadn't gotten far
enough to match names to faces.

dialogues.jp:
足音は、そのまま遠ざかっていく。俺は足を止
め、振り返った。
dialogues.en:
The footsteps faded away quickly behind us. I stopped
walking and turn my head around.
dialogues.text:
The footsteps faded away quickly behind us. I stopped
walking and turn my head around.

dialogues.jp: 「……なあ、ことり」
dialogues.en: "...Hey, Kotori.
dialogues.text: "...Hey, Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「今のって、確か、クラスメートだったよな？」
dialogues.en:
"...That girl just now was one of our classmates, wasn't
she?"
dialogues.text:
"...That girl just now was one of our classmates, wasn't
she?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ああ。そうでしたね。それが？」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, she is. What about it?"
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, she is. What about it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いや……ただ、それだけなんだけど」
dialogues.en: "No... that's not what I meant."
dialogues.text: "No... that's not what I meant."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……まあ、いいや」
dialogues.en: "...Well, never mind."
dialogues.text: "...Well, never mind."

dialogues.jp:
軽く肩をすくめ、歩みを再開した。二歩遅れて、
ことりが歩き出す。
dialogues.en:
I shrugged my shoulders, and resumed walking. After a short
delay, Kotori followed my footsteps.
dialogues.text:
I shrugged my shoulders, and resumed walking. After a short
delay, Kotori followed my footsteps.

dialogues.jp:
ことりだったら、クラスメートには、バイバイ
とか笑顔を向けると思ったんだけど……。
dialogues.en:
I thought Kotori would normally smile and say goodbye to our
classmates...
dialogues.text:
I thought Kotori would normally smile and say goodbye to our
classmates...

dialogues.jp: 気が付かなかったのだろうか？
dialogues.en: I didn't just imagine that all those times, did I?
dialogues.text: I didn't just imagine that all those times, did I?

dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、ことり。また明日」
dialogues.en: "Well, Kotori, till tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "Well, Kotori, till tomorrow."

dialogues.jp:
校門のところで振り返る。やはりことりは、浮
かない顔付きで、心持ち俯くようにしていた。
dialogues.en:
I turned my head around and stated talking again. Her face
still showed her depression.
dialogues.text:
I turned my head around and stated talking again. Her face
still showed her depression.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、ことり」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Kotori."

dialogues.jp: 体調が悪い……だけなんだろうか。
dialogues.en: She's probably not feeling well...
dialogues.text: She's probably not feeling well...

dialogues.jp:
それだけのような気もするし、それだけじゃな
いような気もする。
dialogues.en:
That's what I wanted to think, but I knew inside that that
wasn't all of it.
dialogues.text:
That's what I wanted to think, but I knew inside that that
wasn't all of it.

dialogues.jp:
だが、ことりが言ってくれない限り、俺には知
りようがない。
dialogues.en:
But if Kotori won't say anything about it, there's nothing I
can do.
dialogues.text:
But if Kotori won't say anything about it, there's nothing I
can do.

dialogues.jp:
「帰ったらさ、ゆっくり休めよな。暖かくして
　さ」
dialogues.en: "When you get home, rest well, and stay warm."
dialogues.text: "When you get home, rest well, and stay warm."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う、うん……そうします」
dialogues.en: "O, okay... I will."
dialogues.text: "O, okay... I will."

dialogues.jp:
弱々しげな笑み。猟銃を突きつけられた小動物
を連想してしまう。
dialogues.en:
She smiled weakly. She was like a small animal with a gun
pointed at her.
dialogues.text:
She smiled weakly. She was like a small animal with a gun
pointed at her.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それでは……」
dialogues.en: "Then I'd be off..."
dialogues.text: "Then I'd be off..."

dialogues.jp: 軽く会釈すると、ことりは去っていった。
dialogues.en: With a little bow, Kotori walked off.
dialogues.text: With a little bow, Kotori walked off.

dialogues.jp: （夜、電話してみようかな……）
dialogues.en: "(I should call her tonight...)"
dialogues.text: "(I should call her tonight...)"

dialogues.jp: （って、電話が苦手だって言ってたっけか）
dialogues.en: "(Wait, she did say she didn't like using the phone.)"
dialogues.text: "(Wait, she did say she didn't like using the phone.)"

dialogues.jp:
（明日になったら、元気になってるといいけど
　な……）
dialogues.en: "(I hope she'd feel better tomorrow...)"
dialogues.text: "(I hope she'd feel better tomorrow...)"

dialogues.jp:
その背中が視界から消えるまで見守ってから、
俺は学園を後にしたのだった。
dialogues.en:
I watched her back disappear into the horizon, then left
myself.
dialogues.text:
I watched her back disappear into the horizon, then left
myself.

dialogues.jp: ◆元気のないことり２◆
dialogues.en: ◆Depressed Kotori 2◆
dialogues.text: ◆Depressed Kotori 2◆

dialogues.jp:
校門までことりと一緒する。彼女はやはり、ど
うにも元気がなかった。
dialogues.en:
I walked Kotori to the school hate. She was still feeling
down.
dialogues.text:
I walked Kotori to the school hate. She was still feeling
down.
